explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the HTML fragment in body context, then walked tokens with next_token(), appending only ordinary #text nodes plus TITLE/TEXTAREA opener text via get_modifiable_text(), which the docs say is decoded where appropriate. I truncated the final UTF-8 string by Unicode code points with mb_strlen()/mb_substr() and returned an empty string for non-positive limits or parser creation failure.
